beforeBooking.title: Before Booking Your Egypt Tour Packages
items: Compare different Egypt Tour Packages to choose the one that fits your budget and travel style perfectly.
Read recent customer reviews to ensure you're booking with a reliable and trusted Egypt tour company.
Check if your chosen package includes major attractions like the Pyramids, Luxor Temples, and Nile cruises.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months and apply for your Egypt visa in advance.
Choose a package with clear inclusions like accommodation, transport, guided tours, and entrance fees.
Purchase travel insurance covering health, cancellations, and trip interruptions for peace of mind.
Learn a few basic Arabic words or phrases to enrich your experience and connect with locals.

items.text: Stay well-hydrated and carry bottled water daily, especially during outdoor visits to temples and the desert.
Protect yourself from the sun by wearing sunscreen, sunglasses, and light breathable clothes.
Dress modestly when visiting mosques and cultural sites to respect local traditions and customs.
Carry small Egyptian pounds for tips, local snacks, and market shopping during your guided tours.
Follow your tour guide's instructions closely, especially during historic site visits or desert excursions.
Bargain with a smile in local bazaars, but always agree on prices before finalizing your purchase.
Keep your belongings secure and be aware of your surroundings in crowded tourist areas and markets.
